entities.summary: Zurab Pololikashvili is a Georgian politician and diplomat. He was appointed to be the Secretary-General of the World Tourism Organization and he will serve until the end of 2025. From 2005 to 2009 he was the Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of Georgia, and he served as ambassador to Spain, Morocco, Algeria and Andorra.
